title: 'Man in distress' dies after being shot by police in Montebello, Que.
subtitle: Victim identified as Danny Lafrance-Godmer, 29, of Montebello
article: A 29-year-old man is dead after he was shot during a police operation at a home in Montebello, Que.
The victim has been identified as Danny Lafrance-Godmer of Montebello, Quebec's police watchdog said Friday.

The incident happened at a home in Montebello on Saint François Xavier Street when police responded to a call for a man in distress, according to the bureau des enquêtes indépendentes du Quebec (BEI), which investigates injuries or death involving police in the province.
Sûreté du Québec police officers entered the home and went into the attic, where they found a man armed with a knife, the bureau said in a news release.
The man ran at police and he was shot, the bureau said. He later succumbed to his injuries and died, police said.
Two witnesses told Radio-Canada they heard what sounded like gun shots.
The bureau has assigned nine investigators to the scene and will call upon the Montreal police should they need additional support.
